calculation.expression: gate * -(ret_20 - cross_sectional_median(ret_20)) / max(realized_vol_60, 1e-6), gate = VIX > rolling_median(VIX,120)
calculation.description: Ranks 20-day cross-asset residual losers positively for 20-day forward returns, scaled by 60-day realized volatility and conditioned on elevated VIX relative to its trailing 120-day median. The validation sample had gate active on all usable dates, so the current artifact is empirically equivalent to the un-gated signal over this data window.
